content: 7:1-10 Yisas Rom munon baraitari wonou sarau munon musiarei
Yisas qob eng mom ende wurinob qamb wogub bo Kaperneam isorei.
Isa Rom yogorau munon yurau ger oroar igoar eng wonou sarau betet igoar eng toar aib wara umib pisi igoai.

Yisas ende isa qob toau igub wonou sarau betet igoar eng borusi qenunget igoar end iren uminer qamb Yuda munon baraitari qei wuriimurima irab Yisas nob qamarari et darab musi qamb wuriimurima iramirei.
Irab Yisas qand nob qamamir: “Munon eng ne musierinen eng uber.
Wonou munon baraitari eng in Yuda munon inqenungar ne inorou munai aib eng mindatarerei.”

Ende qamarari Yisas wurinob isorei. Isi pisiari ne bo munon qei wuriimurima irab Yisas gab nob qamamir: “O Munon barai, dibogoten wab qib igoan eng. Ne ye munai mor yarinen eng qeemben ue. Ne gor ye ne menmant irini eng gor uber ue.
Eng gab mugenderi ende igo qobt qas qamara yonou sarau munon uberburiner.

Ye gor munon barai qei, sarau eb yet qamarari ebet igoum. Ne yonou yogorau munon eng wuri ye qob qemerine ye toat igour. Ye igo ger nob ete qemerin eng, “Isi” qemerine eng isub igo. A bo ger nob, “yar” qemerine eng yar igo. Ne yonou sarau besab igo eng nob, “Mi eng eb” ende qemerine ebet igo.”
Yisas munon eng qob ende biga ir qamarari igub qiet ne wot mismisir ne igeser munon yurau toat isub igour eng wurinob qamar: “Ye qoan Isrel munon yurau end munon ger oau apand ende ger me geau.”
Ende qamara wogub munon eng munon wuriimuriamor eng bo mor isub gamir eng wonou sarau munon eng uberetarei igama gamirei.
7:11-17 Yamangar qindou wonou wau igomot der bugamorei
Yisas eng ende at wogub ne bo bais umi-umi ende at wogub wonou yurau wuriimbig qib igoar eng ne munon yurau ar qei toat qib igour eng nob bo munai ginam Nain eng isumirei.

Isi munai ginam qani isub gamir eng munon mumun ger tumunimb qamb ba diamirei. Munon eng yamangar ger umami qoan umorei igama wonou wau gari qas eng nob igoar eng uma wogub munon ginam aib eng nob ba di igurei.
Munon aib yamangar eng wonou wau end borusi mom toubet di igama gab nob qamar: “Me yei.”
Ende qamb ne munon mumun gar eng qani is bea ne munon togor igour eng nagari munon mumun eng nob qamar: “Wau moi, ye ne meni igoum, der bugom.”
Ende nob qamara munon mumun eng der bugab qanambig qob qamara imurima unort isorei.
Munon gugum ende gab qesi igara Qenut igub qamamir: “Qob gigit qamarau Munon aib ger qo init darar eng. Qenu wonou munon yurau eng wurimusierib qamb dara.”
Ende qamb qob bigari munon ginam Yudia ne ginam gugum isa igumirei.
7:18-35 Yat wurimaragansiau Yon Yisas wot qob bigorei

Ne Yon wonou wuriimbig igoar yurau eng mi end gugum nob qamarari igub wogub ne ombur-ombur wurit qamara yarari wuriimurimb qamar: “An irab Munon aib ete qebi gaiar: Ne munon eng gari deriba Yon inimbig qamb igoar eng qiyo, in munon ger bo qoat igoruboun?
Ende qamb ne wuriimurima Yisast irab qamamir: “Yon inimurima diab ne mai munon eng deriba Yon inimbig qamb igoar eng qiyo, in munon ger bo qoat igoruboun?”
Qen end Yisas munon yamangar irou toar ar igab igoar eng qiyo aibigau igaramor eng wurimusub a mag tuum buremir eng wurimusia bo asi qiyo ende-ende atri igoai.

Ende at igama Yon qob eng end ir qamarari taui qamar: “An mi e gagar gab ne qemerine igoumon eng isub Yon nob qamarar: munon mag tuum bo asi mi gaur, ne goten gurumtar eng bo qib igour, a tumau gab igour eng bo woumriroa ar igour, ne munon quum eng bo qob igub igour. Ne munon umour eng bo wurimenima igomot der bugomour, a munon boru-boru eng qob uber igub ende at igour.
Ne munon ger ye ebetri igoum eng gab siningot ye mogirt wab me igoriner eng Qenu wo musia ubereteriba.”
Yon munon ombur eng qoari ne Yisas munon yurau aib eng Yon wot qanam wuriimbig qamar: “Qoan Yon seger ait igama is qoat igamari meimi aba gamanei? Ar moon di qagab bea gub qamb isomanei qiyo?
Ue, aninou ar isomanei ne? A, munon ger mingoan uber qumani igama gub qamb isomanei ne? Munon uber mingoan ende at qumani eng munai uberet igoriba.
Ye nob qamarari igini, meimi gub qamb isomanei? Munon qob gigit qamb igoar eng gub isomanei qiyo? Io, ye ete aninob qemerine igar, munon qob gigit qamb igour eng gugum wuritanamimar eng gub isomanei.
Yon wot Qenu qamara ete gumatemirei,

content.text: Munon e yonou qob ba gigit tap imotet isiba.

content: Qob ende igoar end aninob quraum.” Ende qamb bo qamar: “Yon wo munon qei unor wuri baub igour eng wuritanamima. Ne munon ger, Qenu wonou bibis end igoriner eng wo Yon wotanamima.”
Ne munon ar ne gabmant qur ba igour eng, Yon qob qamara igub: “Qo, Qenu wonou qob apand qamara igub igoun,” ende qamarari ne wurimaragansi ya obotarerei.
A, Parisi ne qomon imbigau yurau eng Yon qob qamara igub Qenu wuriubersierib qamb ebeter eng nugutumugetemir end Yon wuri ya me obotarau.
Ne Yisas qamar: “See ye meimit big munon wurinob qemerini qiyo? Wuri maigas?
Wuri wau qamaaman gas, qei ginamt qiumuni bugab igo qei wurit ete orunor gas,

content.text: in sibemi woroun eng an uru me uyau. A ur umbisau woroun eng an toubet me eau.

content: Eng gas ende Yon munon ya obotarer eng wo diab mi gitab mani wain ya qamb me nia gab, “ai bigau waramai” ende wot qamb igoumon.

A, bo see munangit wau mi nub a ya nub aba an bo der ete qamb igoumon: “Wa munon eng gaiar, wo mani qamb ya qamb niau tari.” Ne gor wo munon Rom gabmant qur ba igour eng nob munon mindigar qoat eng wurimbanamsi qib igo.” Ende qamb igoumon.
A munon Qenu qob igub wot oabig toat obounor eng wuri misir uber igub Qenu qob end apand qomorubour,” ende qamarei.
7:36-50 Yamangar ger welyat Yisas goten qositeterei
Parisi munon ger Yisas nob mi nib qamb wot qamara wonou munai mor end isub bugab mi nub igoai.
Igama ne yamangar qarig ir qib igoar eng, ger ginam end igo Yisas Parisi munai end mi nub igo ende qamarari igub yarib qamb maurem ya qogom sig maieng eng garant igoar eng ten ba yarerei.
Yarab Yisas mogirt end naget igo ea mag ya der Yisas gotent isa wogub ne wonou tari im end baimetet ne ambuget wogub maurem ya ba yarer end wot igimeteterei.

Munon Parisi Yisas wot ara isuor eng, yamangar eng ende aba gab wonou misirt qas qamar: “Wa, munon eng apand qob gigit qamarau igo ende qi eng yamangar wonou qomon boru qarig ir qib igoar eng diban gab imbiga qi.”
Ende qamb igama Yisas der wonou misir eng gab nob qamar: “Saimon, ye mi ger nonob qemerine igu.” Ende qamara Saimon der qamar: “Io, yonob qamara igini.”
Qamara Yisas der qamar: “Munon ombur-ombur, munon geret mi ar baumir eng ger nomon qur qangang K500 ne ger K50 gari.
Ne ombur maigas me tauimunorei eng gab ne wuritaisia wagomirei. Wogub your munon eng sig-sig mom qenungeiba?
Ne Saimon qamar: “Munon nomon qur qangang aib mi bauor eng ombur ende wuritaisia munon nomon qur qangang aib bauor eng wo uberetarei.” Qamara Yisas taui qamar: “Nonou gari qeemben quran eng.”

Ende qamb wogub yamangar eng igeser gab Saimon nob qamar: “Ye set nonou munai mor e yoroum eng ne ye goten me birogonimisau. yamangar e abar eng ne ge. Wo yarab yet ea wogub mag yat ye goten birogoni wogub tari imt baimisar eng ende ge.
Ne ger ye mor diaum eng ne ye me yeambugau, isi yarab see qas yamangar e yesiar eng.
Ne gor maurem yat ye tari im me qosisau, eng yamangar wo maurem ya qogom uber end ye gotent isi qosisar eng ge.

End ne ye nonob quraum, yamangar e wo sig-sig mom ye qenungar eng gab an imbigar: Qenu wo yamangar eng wonou qomon boru irou wot igo end merimotet me weginerei. Wo yamangar eng mom ubersiar end yeqenunget eng abar eng. A munon ger qomon boru gari-gari wot igo end Qenu ubersieriner eng bais-bais yeqenungeiba.”
Ende qamb wogub yamangar eng nob qamar: “Nonou qomon boru end ye namat me qemerinei, ye nemusiaum.”
Ende qamara munon nam qabt bugab igour eng wurinou qob-qob qamamir: “Munon eng your igo qomon boru eng musia?”
Ende qamb igamari Yisas yamangar eng nob qamar: “Nonou oau apand end qomon boru net ubura, sarog big is qib igoar,” ende qamarei.
